verdict.rationale: Tavily documents an official MCP server, including a first-party hosted endpoint (`claude mcp add tavily --transport http https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp/`). It exposes search, extract, crawl, map, and research tools to Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, or any MCP client, and supports OAuth so no API key needs to be hardcoded; a probe confirmed the MCP docs page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually connecting through the MCP server.
